Name: Cat Kids
Author: zzzzzzzhao
Description:
不想养孩子，那就和伴侣一起孵出属于你们的小猫吧。
f you don’t want to raise a child, then hatch your very own kitten with your partner.

同意伴侣的养猫提议后，猫蛋会在三天后到家。连续三个游戏日摸摸猫蛋，就能孵出一只原版大小的猫。
After accepting your spouse’s suggestion, a cat egg will arrive three days later. Pet it on three consecutive days to hatch a full-sized cat.

猫猫会在家里自由活动，使用原版猫咪的走动、坐下、舔毛等动作。保留原版两个养育名额、命名、成长和爱心互动。
Your cats roam around the house using vanilla cat behaviors, including walking, sitting, and grooming. The two-child limit, naming, growth, and heart interactions are preserved.

罗宾出售六种颜色的猫毯，每张 500 金。可以移动、收进背包或重新铺放。猫猫每晚会自行选择一张休息；没有猫毯时，就睡在农夫床上。
Robin sells six blanket colors for 500g each. Move them, pick them up, or place them again. Cats choose a blanket each night, or sleep on the farmer’s bed if none are placed.

已有存档中的原版孩子也会显示为猫。
Existing vanilla children will also appear as cats.
